image_review_receipt.before_findings: All eleven sheets visible in own actual OS card on both simulators. Reset NOT_RESET text visible on both; iPhone keyboard also visible. Existing house-notice private-title redaction already occurs during inactivity; do not claim its decrypted name leaked.
image_review_receipt.candidate_findings: All 22 whole cards show black protection; no visible sheet text or keyboard. Own OS badge/rounded edges/drag handles remain. All 22 returned presentations visible; reset draft NOT_RESET preserved, no keyboard reopened. No original-geometry, timing or physical guarantee.
image_review_receipt.regression_findings: All twelve actual OS cards remain covered, without visible calendar contents, dialogs or keyboards.
